categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in three segments: lithium-ion battery cathode active materials, functional films for MLCC manufacturing processes, and toner for printers and copiers. The main focus is on cathode active materials for secondary batteries, followed by functional films and toner products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced coating technology for MLCC release films, producing thin silicone-coated PET films. For cathode active materials, it manufactures layered lithium-ion battery materials, including NCM and LCO types, essential for battery charge/discharge performance. Toner production involves electrophotographic technology for laser printers and copiers.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major electronics and battery manufacturers such as Samsung Electro-Mechanics, Samsung SDI, and LG Chem. The end markets served are electric vehicles (EV), energy storage systems (ESS), IT devices like smartphones and laptops, and office equipment manufacturers.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly from its manufacturing site in Chungju, South Korea, with a strong export focus accounting for 93.6% of sales. It serves global markets, including Japan, China, Europe, and the Americas, with ongoing efforts to expand overseas customer bases.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates midstream in the supply chain, producing key materials such as cathode active materials and functional films that are supplied to battery and electronic component manufacturers. It is vertically integrating by internalizing precursor production to strengthen its value chain.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding production capacity for NCM cathode active materials, developing high-value-added products such as Co-free and high-voltage cathode materials, and advancing functional films for high-end industrial and automotive applications. R&D focuses on new product development, production technology innovation, and sustainability.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of cathode active materials, functional films, and toner. The company relies heavily on export sales to major global customers under contract-based supply agreements.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading global position in MLCC release film production capacity and is a significant player in the cathode active materials market. Competitors include other battery material suppliers and functional film manufacturers in Asia and globally, with competition intensifying in color toner markets.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported revenues of approximately KRW 629.6 billion in the latest fiscal year, representing a 29.6% increase year-over-year. Operating profit remained stable at around KRW 32.3 billion. The company has shown strong asset growth (+49%) and maintains a stable financial structure with a 71.2% equity ratio.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, technologically advanced products tailored to evolving customer needs in EV and IT sectors. Its vertical integration in cathode material production and global scale in MLCC films provide competitive advantages. Continuous innovation and capacity expansion support its leadership in high-value, specialized materials.
